evidence.quoted_text:
require(payload["record_after"]["sha256"] == payload["record_before"]["sha256"],
            "ambiguous activation recovery changed the retained record")
    require(payload["record_after"]["outcome"] == "pending"
            and payload["record_after"]["phase"] == "activation_pending",
            "ambiguous activation recovery did not retain the pending intent")
    return payload
evidence.reason: In `recovery_refuse`, the post-refusal assertions check only rc 3 and the journal hash/outcome/phase. They do not verify that the service mask, staged service, activator state, or completion log remain unchanged, so a recovery that released the mask while leaving the pending record intact would still pass these lines. This is a routine test-correctness fix, not a new product requirement.
